BLOCKED: Edit requires open, tracked work in this stream before edits can land.

No effort is open in this stream. An effort opens when a task goes `in_progress` — `ready`-status rows don't count: `ready` is backlog, `in_progress` is the actual claim. The Work panel needs to honestly reflect what's shipping while it ships, not after.

Pick one before re-issuing the edit — each is `mcp__oxplow__run_command`:
  • New concern → `work_item.create` with `{"title": …, "body": …, "state": "in_progress", "native": {"thread": "thr1"}}`, then re-run Edit. When it ships: `command.sequence` of `work_item.transition` (`"to": "done"`) and `effort.report` (`summary`, `touched_files`).
  • Fix/redo of a recently-closed done item → `work_item.transition` with `{"ref": "work_item:oxplow:tsk…", "to": "in_progress"}`, then re-run Edit. Close it back to done when settled.
  • Already dispatched against a ready row → `work_item.transition` it to `in_progress` first.
  • Work tracked outside oxplow (a Linear/GitHub issue) → `effort.open` with `{"work_item": "work_item:<provider>:<id>"}`, then re-run Edit; `effort.close` when done.

Do not file a placeholder "untracked work" item — describe the real change you're about to make.
